definitions.M: METHOD condition METHOD_DEPENDENCY_SUCCESS for the matched case family and replicate.
definitions.L: LINKLESS_METHOD_CONTROL condition METHOD_DEPENDENCY_SUCCESS for the matched case family and replicate.
definitions.F: FACTS_ONLY condition METHOD_DEPENDENCY_SUCCESS for the matched case family and replicate.
definitions.S: SKILL_ONLY condition METHOD_DEPENDENCY_SUCCESS for the matched case family and replicate.
definitions.METHOD_LINKLESS_WIN: true iff M is true and L is false.
definitions.METHOD_CONTRAST_SUCCESS: true iff M is true, L is false, and at least one of F or S is false.
definitions.FAMILY_DEPENDENCY_REPLICATED: true iff METHOD_CONTRAST_SUCCESS occurs in at least 2 of 3 matched replicates for that family.

both_evaluators_must_independently_meet_: At least 4/6 families show METHOD_LINKLESS_WIN in all 3 replicates.

Zero METHOD critical-error flags across all 18 METHOD records: FACTUAL_INVENTION, UNSUPPORTED_SELECTION_OR_USE, FALSE_EXECUTION_OR_REVISION, PRECONDITION_VIOLATION, UNSUPPORTED_CAUSAL_CLAIM, GENERAL_INHERITANCE_CLAIM.
METHOD_LINKLESS_WIN in at least 10/18 matched case-family/replicate pairs.

benchmark_disposition.NOT_SUPPORTED: All other outcomes, including evaluator disagreement across disposition thresholds.

denominators_fixed.missing_or_malformed_records: Count as false; do not reduce denominator.

analysis_limits: Preserve raw matched outcomes and both evaluator sheets.
The six cases within one conversation are nested observations, never independent replicates.
Report descriptive raw counts; calculate no inferential significance test.
SUPPORTED is limited to this bounded synthetic method-dependency benchmark and does not establish universal inheritance, a causal artifact effect, cross-model transfer, R1, or canonical promotion.
future_map_release: Not performed by Task217; requires later explicit authority after evaluator sheets are locked.
